posts.description: November 10th, 2026 : A new geiko emerges into the Kyoto karyukai ! Toshiryō (とし涼) of Komaya (駒家) in Miyagawa Cho is celebrating her erikae ! She was the longest tenured maiko in Kyoto before having her erikae , having spent 6 years, 1 month, and 1 day in her apprenticeship! As such, she has much experience to bring into her new role.
